notes: v1.10.5 - Idle guard: the Idle button gets a menu (the ▾ beside it) to set the limit in minutes and choose what counts as you being here - keyboard, macro keys, output links, plugin panel links, the phone companion, broadcasts from another world - with a status line saying what last reset the clock and what was ignored. A movable "Idle guard" HUD panel shows the time left as a bar. When the guard fires it now also holds every plugin: plugin timers stop and anything a plugin sends is dropped until you are back (on by default, untick it in the menu). Plugins: the Stepper now stops in mid-fight too, for the idle guard and for .stop (1.1.2); Auto-Raid disarms (2.3.2); Viking Status disarms auto-trade and stops the 5-minute vtick keepalive (2.27.3). Fixed ANSI colour after a '<' showing as raw codes such as [1m in `who`.
